'''Chapter 369''' is titled "Ramen Kenpo".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: "Crash! We Can Fight It!"

Framed portraits of all the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], placed in a jumble, each counting off the Straw Hat's join-order. [[Usopp]] is depicted in his Sogeking guise, while [[Nico Robin|Robin]] is depicted behind a chain to symbolize her captivity.

==Short Summary==
[[Sanji]] fights [[Wanze]] while [[Franky]] prepares to battle [[Nero]]. Meanwhile, [[Usopp|Sogeking]] has managed to reach the first coach!

==Long Summary==
The [[CP9]] are informed of the last two coaches being disconnected and that those in the fifth coach have been easily defeated. It is revealed that [[Nico Robin]] is in the first cart of the train and that the CP9 and [[Wanze]] are the only ones left to prevent her from being taken. They are also informed of the attackers appearances and conclude that the only thing they have to do is take both [[Franky]] and Nico Robin to [[Enies Lobby]] alive. They decide to focus on capturing Franky since saving Robin is impossible.

Meanwhile, on Coach Four, Wanze continues to prevent them from passing and [[Sanji]] decides to fight him while the other two progress to the next coach. He continues to prevent them from passing until Sanji attacks making him dodge and allowing the other two to pass. Wanze explains that [[Nero]] is in the next coach before being kicked by Sanji twelve times. Due to this, he uses [[Ramen Kenpo]] to create an armor around him.

Franky is greeted by Nero on the roof of the next coach and it is explained he cannot kill him since they need him alive. Franky lands the first hit after tricking Nero stating that he plays dirty since he is the underworld boss of his town.

In the first coach, Nico Robin hears a knock at the window and is shocked to see [[Usopp|Sogeking]] there.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*A Marine officer informs [[CP9]] of the current situation onboard the [[Puffing Tom]], which only has 5 cars left as the rest were detached.
**[[Wanze]] is in the 4th car.
**[[Nero]] is in the 3rd car.
**CP9 is currently present in the 2nd car.
**[[Nico Robin]] is in the 1st car.
*The Marine officer describes the appearances of their attackers, consisting of [[Franky]], [[Usopp|Sogeking]], and [[Sanji|a blonde man wearing a suit]]. Kaku speculates that the blonde man is also a member of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] and their objective is to recapture Robin with Franky helping them.
*CP9 disregards any other threats and focuses on recapturing Franky, with [[Rob Lucci]] proclaiming that they will never be successful in recapturing Robin.
*Sanji, Sogeking and Franky confront Wanze in the 4th car.
**Wanze is a user of [[Ramen Kenpo]]. 
*Sanji tells Sogeking and Franky to move on to the next car while he handles Wanze.
*Wanze reveals that Nero is also a member of CP9 and he loves killing.
*Franky confronts Nero on top of the 3rd car, as Nero assumed that Franky would have attempted to skip past him.
*Sogeking skips to the 1st car and alerts Robin by knocking on her window.
